records.label: Schema.org Property Mapping
records.notes: Maps an individual field to a compatible Schema.org property for machine-readable structured data. Upstream ACF 6.8 marks the overall Schema feature experimental; WPE should preserve explicit lifecycle visibility rather than hiding that maturity state.

records.label: Schema.org Output Format
records.notes: Controls how a mapped field value is transformed for JSON-LD output; valid formats depend on the field type and selected Schema.org property.

records.label: Allow AI Access for Field Group
records.notes: Current ACF 6.8 provides per-item AI access for field groups through the WordPress Abilities API. This is group-level governance and is distinct from the existing field-level AI access possibility.

records.label: Field Group AI Description
records.notes: Optional semantic description that gives AI/automation tooling context about the field group when AI access is enabled.

records.label: Per-field REST Read Permission
records.notes: Pods exposes field-level REST read enablement independently from global REST policy. WPE should model this as a field-level projection permission, not a duplicate of generic field visibility.

records.label: Per-field REST Write Permission
records.notes: Pods exposes field-level REST write enablement independently from global REST policy. This is distinct from read exposure and from runtime authorization provider behavior.

records.label: Relationship REST Response Type
records.notes: Controls relationship serialization depth/shape at the API boundary. Pods documents Full, ID Only and Name Only response types.

records.label: Relationship REST Traversal Depth
records.notes: Bounds how far full relationship responses traverse nested related data, preventing accidental large payload/query explosions.

records.label: Custom Table Foreign Key Constraints
records.notes: ACPT markets foreign keys alongside indexes for custom database tables. WPE should expose explicit relational integrity semantics only where the selected storage adapter supports them.

coverage.notes: Market-audit delta proven by current 2026 provider documentation: ACF 6.8 semantic/Abilities settings, Pods REST granularity and relationship projection controls, and ACPT custom-table foreign keys.
